name: cypress-mini-shop
description: Modular Cypress Test Suite for a Modern Web App (Cypress Mini Shop)

scripts.cy:parallel: concurrently "npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/auth/login.cy.js" "npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/dashboard/products.cy.js" "npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/dashboard/flakiness.cy.js"
scripts.test:all: npm run cy:parallel && npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate
